attributes.readMe: ## Image File Preview — pixels (IP) One of the two components behind the **Media File Preview** row, and the simplest renderer in the family. **The browser is the decoder.** This is one native `` via the `FileImage` primitive. The component's entire job is *choosing how the pixels meet the frame it is handed* — nothing else. It is also a **content-only** component exported from the `file-formats/index` barrel, so an embedding author can render just the pixels with no shell chrome. That author then owns the loading and failure states, because `FilePreviewStage` is not in the tree. At 198 lines it is deliberately the thinnest renderer here: anything more would be re-implementing what the browser already does well. Projected into the four format shells by `FilePreviewStage`, which owns the loading, failure and staleness panes.
